Non-Functional and Business Rules: Payments Service

The system must process a payment in under three seconds at the 95th percentile.
The service shall maintain 99.9 percent availability measured monthly.
All payment data must be encrypted at rest and in transit.
Only administrators are allowed to issue refunds above one thousand dollars.
A customer must not place an order below the minimum order value of five dollars.
The system shall apply a ten percent discount only to verified loyalty members.
The platform must scale to handle ten thousand concurrent users during peak hours.
Refund requests must be approved within two business days per company policy.
